description:
COMING JAN 21ST 2022

Into 2022 running, Laroye teams up with the brilliant Abi Flynn for a series of stellar releases. Beautifully loosened broken beats smothered in complex & warm musical textures give Abi vocals a wonderful bed to rest upon. ABI FLYNN has an unmistakable, angelic tone which lends great definition & character to this brilliant slice of music.

Tom 'Laroye' also backs this one up with two well-crafted Afro Deep mixes that add even more sophistication and dance-floor appeal to the release.

Tom has over the last few years, built an incredible collection of high-quality output for labels such as FREERANGE, OCHA, LOCAL TALK & FOLIAGE to name only a few. and let us not forget his incredible QWESTLIFE releases with YAM WHO?'S 'ANDY WILLIAMS' on MIDNIGHT RIOT & Defected's 'GLITTERBOX' label.
